stories.title: Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the data contract for proximity including distance (miles/km), travel_time (minutes), origin (normalized user location), destination (trial site coordinates), units, and calculation metadata. Include null/unknown handling for missing locations and ensure compatibility with clinical trials models.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Time Calculation Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to compute distance and travel time between normalized user location and each clinical trial site using Google Routes. Handle multiple sites per trial, coordinate normalization, and consistent unit conversion.

stories.title: Proximity API Exposure via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose proximity metrics through the evaluate care facade so trial results include distance and travel time per site, formatted for conversational output and aligned with existing response structures.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculations
stories.description: Develop tests validating distance and travel time accuracy, unit consistency, handling of missing/invalid user or site locations, and multi-site trial scenarios.

stories.title: Google Routes Integration and Error Handling
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API within the clinical trials service including request construction, response parsing, timeout handling, and graceful fallback when routing data is unavailable.
